subject: general
question: Which of the following companies has developed India's first mRNA-based vaccine against COVID-19, which was found to be safe and got the approval for phase II and III trials in the year 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gennova Biopharmaceuticals Ltd**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The company that developed India's first mRNA-based vaccine against COVID-19, which was found to be safe and got approval for Phase II and III trials in 2021, is **Gennova Biopharmaceuticals**.
 
• The vaccine is known as **HGCO19**, 
 
• It was a significant step in India's vaccine development efforts, utilizing messenger RNA (mRNA) technology, which had already been used in vaccines like those from Pfizer and Moderna.
 
• Pfizer is a messenger RNA (mRNA) vaccine. 
 
• This type of vaccine uses a genetic code called RNA to make your body's cells produce the coronavirus’ specific spike protein.
 
• Pfizer, a US-based pharma giant, and BioNTech, a German biotechnology company, have together manufactured this vaccine.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Serum Institute of India**

 
 
• **​**Serum Institute of India (SII) developed **Covishield**, the Indian version of the Oxford-AstraZeneca vaccine.
 
• This vaccine **was one of the first approved for emergency use in India** and was widely distributed during the COVID-19 vaccination drive.
 
 
 
• **Bharat Biotech**
 
 
• **​**Bharat Biotech is a **pioneering biotechnology company known for its world-class R&D and manufacturing capabilities**
 
• **Dr. Krishna Ella is the Executive Chairman of Bharat Biotech** International Limited, which he incorporated in 1996
 
• The **Hungarian Károly Ereky coined the word "biotechnology" in Hungary during **1919 to describe a technology based on converting raw materials into a more useful product
 
 
 
• **Wockhardt Ltd**
 
 
• **​Wockhardt is an Indian pharmaceutical and biotechnology company** headquartered in Mumbai, India.
 
• It produces f**ormulations, biopharmaceuticals, nutrition products, vaccines and active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs)**.
 
• The company has manufacturing plants in India, UK, Ireland, France and US, and subsidiaries in US, UK, Ireland and France.
